title: Now try it on your own computer
drDigitalIntro:
You have typed, selected, formatted and used shortcuts on a practice keyboard. Now use your real one.
• Open any program you can type in — a notes app, an email, even the search box in your browser.
• Type a sentence, select it with Shift and the arrow keys, and copy it with Ctrl+C (or Command+C on a Mac).
• Paste it somewhere else with Ctrl+V, then undo with Ctrl+Z.
• The keys are in the same places on your keyboard as they were on the practice one.
drDigitalSuccess: Those shortcuts work in almost every program you will ever use.
drDigitalHint: Read along, then try it in any program on your own computer.
